_readme: Single source for public events. scripts/render.py turns this into the homepage event feature, each event page, and the assistant's event facts. Use "To be announced" for anything unconfirmed. Set status to "sample" for demonstration events and "confirmed" only after Pau confirms the details.

events.title: Freelance 101: Start Your Freelancing Journey with Confidence
events.summary: An introductory session for anyone curious about freelancing: what the work really involves, how to find a direction that suits you, and how to prepare for your first client.
events.audience: Students, fresh graduates, career shifters, and beginners exploring freelancing.
takeaways: Identify a niche that suits you
Build confidence in starting your freelance journey
Take clear next steps toward becoming a freelancer
